messages:
Maya Chen: midweek pulse — quick token/throughput check for AtlasCorp? saw some odd spend + a latency bump overnight. can folks drop numbers? :pulse:
Jordan Alvarez: yup, pulling numbers now. give me 2.
deploy-bot: automated snapshot: account=AtlasCorp | period=WoW | tokens=+9.8% | avg_throughput=2.4k tpm | p95_latency=340ms | errors=0.8% | spend=+14%
Amir Patel: thanks, seeing the same. QoQ comparison: tokens +32%, spend +28% (model upgrade + more QPS during batch jobs).
Maya Chen: can you paste the per-route split? curious if it's concentrated on one endpoint (chat vs embeddings).
Jordan Alvarez: paste from prod-stats:
```
/chat.generate: tokens +12% WoW, throughput 1.6k tpm, p95 310ms
/embeddings.encode: tokens +3% WoW, throughput 600 tpm, p95 420ms
/rerank.batch: tokens +40% WoW, throughput 220 tpm, p95 1.1s
```
Elena Rossi: rerank.batch looks like the outlier — it's our new ML cadence for search experiments. I asked Atlas to throttle evening runs but they want nightly spikes. we could propose windowed batching or dedicated pool.
Amir Patel: error spike note: Friday 03:20 UTC saw errors jump to 3.6% for ~12m due to fallback to smaller model (OOM on primary). logs show KV cache eviction increased. suggest config: enable prefix KV cache, raise soft mem limit, or route to Dedicated pool during their nightly window.
Maya Chen: renewal risk? Atlas is in pilot -> goal to convert to Dedicated next quarter. spend rise is expected but we should flag if unit cost goes up 10%+ QoQ. current unit cost change ~7% QoQ after quantization changes so still within threshold.
Jordan Alvarez: quick calc: unit_cost = spend / tokens
unit_cost WoW: $0.00095 (up from $0.00089)
QoQ unit_cost: $0.00092 (baseline)
so WoW bump is small, but nightly rerank spikes push daily peak costs.
Amir Patel: short-term remediation:
- enable prefix KV cache for their rerank routes
- add per-route QoS to cap concurrency at peak window
- schedule a 30-min enablement to walk through batching + model sizing
Elena Rossi: I can run enablement Thurs 15:00 PT with Atlas SWE + infra. Maya, can you own the invite?
Maya Chen: will do. also adding an eval set to track quality delta if we quantize further — want to avoid regressions before recommending aggressive quantization.
Jordan Alvarez: any objections to opening a Dedicated trial for 2 weeks for night-window rerank to prove stability/cost delta?
Elena Rossi: SGTM. I'll prep the trial template + cost projection.
Maya Chen: next steps summary:
- Elena: prep Dedicated trial + cost projection (ETA Tue)
- Amir: enable prefix KV cache & adjust soft mem limit on staging, run 24h smoke
- Jordan: monitor unit_cost and peak error rate, post daily summary
- Maya: schedule enablement Thurs 15:00 PT + invite Atlas
If anything urgent ping @here. :thumbsup:
__notes: This Slack thread is a concise midweek customer success sync focusing on token usage and throughput trends, with an action-oriented cadence and short technical notes.
